gloss: here you are; please go ahead; yes, certainly

definitions.gloss: here you are; please go ahead; yes, certainly
definitions.explanation: A polite expression used when handing something to someone, when granting permission or inviting someone to proceed, or when responding affirmatively to a request or knock.

examples.japanese: 「⟦お{水|みず}→お水：23575_omizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦いただけます→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。」「はい、どうぞ。」
examples.english: "Could I have some water?" "Here you are."

examples.japanese: 「⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{資料|しりょう}→資料：04166_shiryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。」「はい、どうぞ。」
examples.english: "May I look at these documents?" "Yes, please go ahead."

examples.japanese: ⟦{店員|てんいん}→店員：00897_tenin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧「はい、どうぞ」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}い→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧、⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{手渡|てわた}した→手渡す：12757_tewatasu⟧。
examples.english: The store clerk said "Here you are" while handing over the item.

notes:
Used as a polite response when handing something to someone or granting a request. The はい affirms the request and ⟦どうぞ→どうぞ：02920_douzo⟧ invites the action.

- ⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{渡|わた}す→渡す：02442_watasu⟧とき (when handing something over): はい、どうぞ
